source_review.notes: Checked primary or publisher records for selection overfitting, random search, ParamILS, SMAC, nested cross-validation, hyperparameter optimization, optimization-experiment methodology, and performance analysis. Machine-learning results are used only for the general finite-sample selection mechanism and remain translated carefully to algorithm configuration.

evidence: Defined legal configuration space, tuning/confirmation risk, target risk, budget, seed, and tuning procedure.
Checked objective direction, milliseconds, percentages, weights, constraints, trial budgets, and fidelity language.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The configured artifact and full selection procedure are distinguished throughout.

evidence: Recomputed A/B/C tuning means 10, 11, and 11, frozen A holdout 20, and invalid pooled winner C.
Recomputed Exercise 2 means 11, 11.5, and 11 with lexicographic winner A.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Holdout results never replace a frozen winner within the same reported selection.

evidence: Reviewed argmin selection and the decomposition of measured tuning risk into target risk plus noise.
Enumerated two independent symmetric error terms and obtained mean selected noise -0.5 despite zero marginal means.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The selection-optimism argument does not require every estimator to be biased individually.

evidence: Reviewed winners at range boundaries, conditional/illegal settings, timeouts, wrong answers, prunes, optimizer-seed variance, low-fidelity rank reversal, and sharp optima.
Reviewed dependent trace leakage, machine and time drift, rare large inputs, one-sided baseline tuning, holdout reuse, and configuration complexity.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Correctness, quality, safety, and resource constraints precede ranking.

evidence: Checked split disjointness, frozen space/budget/objective, complete trial ledger, holdout nonfeedback, baseline fairness, and deployment guard invariants.
Checked that deterministic tie-breaking and pooled-leakage demonstrations select their stated configurations.
invariant_checking.notes: Every retuning campaign creates a new version and needs fresh confirmation.

evidence: Reviewed why minimization over noisy estimates favors negative noise and why untouched confirmation breaks that feedback for the frozen choice.
Reviewed nested-evaluation premises: all selection and preprocessing repeat inside each outer training split.
proof_review.notes: No holdout or nested design is claimed valid beyond its dependency and population assumptions.

evidence: Audited best, incumbent, optimum, near-optimal, unbiased, confirmation, exploratory, robust, censored, and infeasible language.
Separated selection score, confirmation estimate, procedure evaluation, deployed configuration, and future drift.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: A boundary winner is not called a proven optimum.

evidence: The CPython 3.14.4 snippet produced exact tuning means, frozen winner, holdout result, and invalid pooled winner on macOS 13.7.8 x86_64.
Independent enumeration verified selection optimism and exercise tie-breaking.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Fixture execution illustrates leakage mechanics; it does not estimate generalization for a production tuner.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed configuration contracts, objectives, dependency splits, baseline fairness, selection optimism, search-space design, search strategies, replication, failures, budgets, sensitivity, transfer, and deployment.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed conditional schemas, exact trial ledger, resource budgets, timeouts/prunes, optimizer seeds, reproducible recovery, raw outcomes, frozen confirmation, supported-domain guards, fallback, monitoring, and retuning triggers.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter explains selection overfitting from first principles, compares practical search methods, supplies one executable leakage demonstration, ten distinct examples, and five progressive exercises with complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, statistical, optimizer-vendor, machine-learning, performance, operations, or production review is claimed. Conclusions remain conditional on configuration space, parameter semantics, workload dependencies, objective and constraints, search and optimizer seeds, budget, fidelity, failure rules, trial noise, confirmation design, environment, platform, toolchain, and deployment drift.
